---

### **Understanding the Structure**

The video begins with a **3D structure** composed of **smaller cubes**, arranged in a way that forms a **multi-layered cube**. The structure is shown to be **colorful and geometric**, with **multiple layers** of cubes. The key is that this is a **solid 3D structure**, not a hollow or abstract shape.

The phrase **"considering only the side faces"** implies that we are only interested in the **lateral faces** of the structure — that is, the **faces that are adjacent to the edges** of the structure, and **not the top or bottom** faces.

---

### **Clarifying "Side Faces" in a Parallel Projection**

In **orthogonal projection** (a type of parallel projection), the **faces that are visible** in a **2D plane** depend on the **orientation of the projection**.

- If the projection is **parallel to the top face** (i.e., the front or back face), then the **top and bottom faces** will be visible.
- If the projection is **parallel to a side face** (e.g., the left or right face), then **only the side faces** (front, back, left, right) will be visible.
- If the projection is **parallel to the side faces**, then the **maximum number of visible faces** corresponds to the **four lateral faces** of the structure.

---

### **Key Insight**

A **standard cube** has **6 faces** in total. However, when projecting **parallel to one of the side faces**, we **only see the four lateral faces** (front, back, left, right), **excluding the top and bottom faces**.

- The **maximum number of visible square faces** in such a projection is therefore the number of **side faces** that can be seen.
- In a **solid cube**, **all four side faces** are visible in a **parallel projection**.
- The structure in the video appears to be a **solid cube**, and the **projection is parallel to one of the side faces**.

---

### **Why 4?**

- The **side faces** of a cube are **4 in number** (front, back, left, right).
- In a **parallel 2D projection** (e.g., along the x-axis), **only the side faces** (not the top/bottom) are visible.
- Therefore, the **maximum number of visible square faces** is **4**.

---

### ✅ **Final Answer**

$$
\boxed{4}
$$
